name: Felicie Faret
source:
A pious Hand and former Outer Shield patrol devastated by [spoiler]Commander Langlais' destruction of the Hollow Temple.[/spoiler] Hailing from a line of proud officers, Fel was bound for the Shield before she had even once considered her own wants. Left alone, she might not have considered them at all.

(in-game profile)
